questions.text: A sum of ₹717 becomes ₹874.74 in 5 years at a certain rate of simple interest. If the rate of interest is increased by 3.1%, then what will be the simple interest (in ₹) of ₹717 in 5 years?

The rate of oil is increased by 12% every year. The rate in the next year would be ₹125.44 per litre. What is the difference between the prices (in ₹) per litre of the oil in the last year and this year?
The average of 10 numbers is 29. The average of the first 6 numbers is 22 and that of the last 6 numbers is 32. What is the average of the 5th number and the 6th number?
A, B and C start running around a circular track and complete one round in 16, 20 and 28 seconds, respectively. In how much time will they meet again at the starting point?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
Sohan buys 16 oranges for ₹80 and sells 30 oranges for ₹168. Find the percentage of his profit.
The difference between successive discounts of 25% followed by 12% and 20% followed by 15% on the marked price of a saree is ₹50. The marked price of the saree is:
The average of 5 consecutive natural numbers is 7. Which is the largest number among these?
What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
The average of 11 numbers is 17. If the average of the first five numbers is 16 and the average of the last five numbers is 19, then the sixth number is:
Find the total surface area of a cone having base radius 49 cm and slant height 61 cm.

A cylinder has curved surface area equal to area of the flat surfaces of the cylinder. If the diameter of the cylinder is r units, then the total surface area of the cylinder (in square units) will be _____.

A thief saw a policeman from a distance of 300 m and started running. At the same time, the policeman started chasing the thief. If the speed of the thief is 12 km/h and that of the policeman 15 km/h, then the distance (in km) covered by the policeman to catch the thief is:

There are 20 cricket balls in the showroom. Among these 20 balls, some are yellow and some are white. The average cost of all the balls is ₹75. If the average cost of yellow balls is ₹80 and that of white is ₹60, then the number of yellow balls is:

The given bar graph shows the marks obtained by five students in Exam I and Exam II.Study the graph carefully to answer the question that follows. The marks obtain by Naveen in Exam-II are what per cent of the total marks obtained by all five students in Exam-II?
